name: absolute-paths-at-tool-boundary
body:
The graph is persisted with checkout-independent (repo-relative) identities, and absolute paths are reconstructed only at the tool boundary: the suite tools receive a project `directory` and resolve stored identities to absolute filesystem paths against it before returning them to an agent or editor. This keeps the durable artifact portable while the agent-facing contract stays "real paths it can read".

Acceptance criteria:
- `apg query` over a branch DB returns the stored repo-relative identity (the raw graph view).
- The curated suite tools (`apg_file_path`, `apg_file_units`, `apg_hunk`, …) return absolute paths resolved against the project directory.
- Opening a path returned by a suite tool with the `read` tool succeeds inside the project worktree.
